summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide the infrastructure to train, fine-tune, track experiments, govern, and deploy models at scale—handling data pipelines, compute orchestration, model registries, and serving that a raw model API alone does not address. You need a full platform when you're building custom models, managing many experiments and teams, requiring governance/compliance, or deploying at production scale; a simple model API suffices when you only consume a pre-built foundation model for inference without custom training or MLOps overhead. The market splits between cloud-native suites (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML), data-centric lakehouse platforms (Databricks), automated/enterprise AutoML vendors (DataRobot, H2O.ai), and specialized MLOps/compute tools (Weights & Biases, Modal).

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute instance-hour, storage, and endpoint usage; no upfront fees
platforms.best_for: Teams with strong ML engineering capacity, complex workflow requirements, and AWS as the strategic cloud needing deep AWS-native infrastructure alignment

platforms.name: Microsoft Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute, with reserved and spot options; no platform surcharge beyond underlying resources
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft ecosystem; scored top on GigaOm Enterprise Readiness benchmark for managed endpoints

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute, prediction nodes, and managed service usage
platforms.best_for: Teams with limited ML engineering resources and standard workflows wanting opinionated simplicity and strong GenAI/foundation model integration

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based DBU pricing on top of cloud compute; tiered by workload
platforms.best_for: Organizations prioritizing a unified data, analytics, ML, and AI governance layer with multi-cloud flexibility to reduce platform fragmentation

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; per-seat/usage-based paid plans; enterprise custom pricing
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and model lineage layered on top of any training stack

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.best_for: Enterprises wanting automated model building and governance with minimal data science staffing

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise subscription for Driverless AI and managed cloud
platforms.best_for: Organizations needing open-source-friendly AutoML with strong explainability and GenAI tooling

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second serverless compute billing by CPU/GPU usage; free starter credits
platforms.best_for: Developers and teams wanting fast, serverless GPU compute for training and deploying models without managing infrastructure

platforms.name: Amazon Bedrock
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by tokens/inference, with provisioned throughput options
platforms.best_for: Enterprises building GenAI applications on managed foundation models within AWS without managing training infrastructure

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.pricing: Free tier; Pro subscription; usage-based inference endpoints; enterprise plans
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source models who need a hub for models/datasets plus managed training and inference
